name: South African Lamb
description: A flavorful lamb stew with dried fruits, curry powder, and orange juice, simmered to tender perfection.
recipeIngredient: 2½ cups chopped dried fruit (apples, apricots, raisins, etc.)
Rice, bulgar, or couscous for serving

recipeInstructions.text: Combine dried fruit, orange juice, and hot water. Let stand for 1 to 2 hours to soak.
Brown the lamb cubes and drain on paper towels.
Sauté the chopped onion until soft, then reduce heat to low and stir in curry powder.
Add the soaked fruit and 1 cup of soaking liquid to the pan. Stir in vinegar, sugar, and tomato paste.
Return the browned lamb to the pan, cover, and simmer for 1 hour.
Uncover and allow the liquid to reduce to desired consistency.
Serve with rice, bulgar, or couscous.

keywords: South African lamb, lamb stew, curry lamb, dried fruit

_similar.name: Roasted Lamb
_similar.description: A slow-roasted lamb recipe with a flavorful garlic and rosemary paste, perfect for a tender and aromatic main course.

recipeInstructions.text: Make a paste with olive oil, butter, garlic, and rosemary.
Make small holes in the lamb and insert garlic cloves or pieces.
Smear the lamb with the prepared paste.
Sprinkle with flour and place in a roasting pan.
Add a scant amount of water to the pan and sprinkle rosemary on top.
Roast slowly at 250°F to 300°F for 6 to 7 hours or until done.
Remove the lid near the end to brown the lamb.

_similar.keywords: roasted lamb, garlic and rosemary, slow cooking

_similar.name: Meat Balls and Sour And Sweet Sauce
_similar.description: A classic meatball recipe served in a tangy sweet and sour sauce, perfect for serving over meatballs, chicken, or pork chops.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp onion flakes or 1 tsp real onion

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together and form into 1½ inch balls.
Bake in an ungreased oblong pan for 20 to 25 minutes at 400°F.
Remove from oven and drain grease.
Place meatballs in a large casserole.
Pour sweet and sour sauce over the top and return to oven for 10 minutes or until hot.
To make the sauce, mix all ingredients together in a saucepan and stir while bringing to a boil until thickened.

_similar.keywords: meatballs, sweet and sour sauce, baked meatballs

_similar.name: Nacho Salad
_similar.description: A spicy nacho salad with ground beef, lettuce, tomatoes, and nacho chips, topped with a creamy dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese (or mozzarella), shredded

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef with onion and garlic. Drain excess fat.
Add spices and water to the beef mixture. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes. Let cool for 10 minutes.
In a large salad bowl, mix together the shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, shredded cheese, and crushed nacho chips.
In a separate bowl, mix the mayonnaise, relish, ketchup, and hot pepper sauce.
Pour the dressing over the salad and add the cooled meat mixture.
Toss the salad to combine all ingredients and serve.

_similar.keywords: nacho salad, spicy salad, ground beef salad

_similar.name: Stir-Fry Beef
_similar.description: A quick and flavorful beef stir-fry with vegetables and a savory sauce, served over cooked rice.
recipeIngredient: 2 lb boneless beef sirloin, cut into pieces
1 large green pepper, cut into strips

recipeInstructions.text: Heat vegetable oil in a frying pan.
Add beef and stir-fry until cooked through. Set aside.
Add peppers and onion to the pan and stir-fry until tender.
Stir in the mixture of tomato soup, soya sauce, orange juice, and vinegar. Cook until heated through.
Return beef to the pan and heat through, stirring occasionally.
Serve the beef mixture over cooked rice.

_similar.name: Pork Chops with Dried Fruit
_similar.description: A savory and sweet dish featuring pork chops cooked with assorted dried fruits in a flavorful orange juice sauce.
recipeIngredient: 1½ cups assorted dried fruit (apples, peaches, pears, apricots, raisins)

recipeInstructions.text: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add oil and cook pork chops until golden brown on each side, about 6 to 8 minutes per side. Remove chops to a plate.
Reduce heat, add 1 cup orange juice to the skillet, and scrape any browned bits from the pan. Bring to a boil.
Add the remaining orange juice, dried fruit, Worcestershire sauce, and allspice. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Mix cornstarch with a small amount of water or juice. Stir into the skillet and cook until the sauce thickens, about 15 minutes.
Return pork chops to the skillet and cook until heated through. Serve with rice or couscous.

_similar.keywords: pork chops, dried fruit, orange juice sauce, savory sweet dish
